resources.string: Calls and live video, no internet needed
MeshLive connects phones directly over Bluetooth. It works with no signal, no Wi-Fi, and where the internet is blocked.
Voice or video, encrypted from phone to phone.
Share video, or audio only like a radio, with everyone nearby.
Each phone reaches about 10 to 30 metres. Phones in between can carry a call or a stream further.
Nothing goes to the internet. Strangers see a random name, not who you are.
Android asks you for each one. You can change them later in Android settings.
To find and connect to phones around you.
Older Android needs it to use Bluetooth. MeshLive never reads where you are.
For video calls and going live.
So your phone rings when someone calls.
Keep working with the screen off
So calls still ring and phones can pass video along while your screen is off. It uses extra battery only while a call, a live video or a relay is on.
Done. MeshLive can keep working with the screen off.
Not allowed. You can change this later in Settings.
Add people you trust in Contacts by scanning each other\'s QR code. Then they can call you by name.
